description: This file implements a board testing utility for the rusEfi firmware, including pin toggling, ADC processing, and user interaction for testing hardware components.

methods.name: isBoardTestMode
methods.description: Returns whether the board test mode is active.

methods.name: printBoardTestState
methods.description: Prints the current state of the board test, including current pin and ADC info.

methods.name: initBoardTest
methods.description: Initializes and starts the board testing process, including pin blinking and ADC testing.
